Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on identifying DUB substrates by measuring changes in total protein abundance (proteome-wide scale) following inhibitor treatment. While the study discusses ubiquitin and DUBs, the proteomics assay itself is a global protein abundance measurement using TMT and MS3, not a PTM-enrichment assay (e.g., no diGly or QQTGG enrichment was performed for the MS runs described).

scope: Cell pellets were lysed by resuspending in lysis buffer (8 M urea, 50 mM NaCl, 50 mM EPPS pH 8.5, 1× Roche protease inhibitor, and 1× Roche PhosphoStop) and passing through a 21 gauge × 1.25 inch needle 20 times.
Protein concentration of the cell lysate was determined by micro-BCA assay (Pierce) according to the manufacturer protocol.

Lysis buffer (8 M Urea, 50 mM NaCl, 50 mM 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)-1-piperazineethanesulfonic acid (EPPS) pH 8.5, Protease and Phosphatase inhibitors from Roche) was added to the cell pellets and homogenized by 20 passes through a 21-gauge (1.25 in. long) needle to achieve a cell lysate with a protein concentration between 1 - 4 mg/mL.
